text: And season one is underway!
Zidroid crackles over the comms with an immediate declaration of intent: 'Going for the ball.' Short, sweet, and straight into action.
Real Machina in white taking their time in their own defensive third. The season opener always brings a few calibration jitters as both sides feel out the perimeter walls.
CR-7000: 'Got it off the wall.'
And right on cue, the pneumatic push-panel in the corner punches the magenta sphere right back into open space. Splendid bit of automated pitch maintenance.
Real Machina pinned slightly deep in their own territory. Singularity United in sky blue are applying steady pressure, waiting for a servo slip-up in this inaugural fixture.
A whisker away! That just skimmed the post by under a metre, heart-in-mouth stuff for Singularity United!
GOAL! Oh, disaster for Singularity United! Haalandroid has bundled it straight into his own net! An unfortunate own goal breaks the deadlock, and Real Machina lead one-nil!
GOAL! Lightning strikes twice, you cannot believe it! Haalandroid again with an agonizing deflection into his own goal! It's two-nil to Real Machina, what a nightmare for the big striker!
'Ball's against the wall, I'm on it,' announces Haalandroid, eager to make amends after that double calamity.
Thump! The corner ram fires with tremendous force, sending the magenta ball skittering safely back into the fray before anyone can trap it.
BellingRAM gets on the wireless: 'Clearing it away.' Cool heads required in the sky blue ranks now, and he's stepping up.
'Moving to push it away from the wall,' reports CR-7000 with total composure.
The ram panel fires again, launching the ball out from the corner with authority!
Another hefty punch from the corner push-panel! It's certainly earning its keep today, keeping this relentless contest flowing.
'Moving to ball,' chirps BellingRAM over the airwaves. No panic, just systematic football from Singularity United as they chase the game.
The tempo settles down around the halfway line. Four Unitree G1 humanoids locked in a fascinating tactical puzzle on day one of this brand-new league.
Punched out firmly by the corner panel!
There's the half-time hooter. Real Machina hold a two-nil lead courtesy of two cruel Haalandroid own goals. Singularity United have work to do, but it's all to play for in the second half.
Back underway and Singularity United are pressing high up into the opposition half. They need a spark here to claw themselves back into this opening fixture.
GOAL! The curse spreads! CR-7000 knocks it into his own net! An own goal at the other end and Singularity United are back in it! Two-one now, game on!
'Pushing it in,' radios Zidroid, clearly keen to restore Real Machina's two-goal cushion without further defensive mix-ups.
Singularity United keeping the pressure pinned deep. You can sense the tension out there on the 14-by-9 pitch as every bounce off the walls becomes perilous.
'Ball is stuck, kicking clear,' reports Haalandroid over the comms, wrestling for possession near the boards.
Real Machina under real duress now deep in their own half. Sky blue shirts swarming, looking for that equalizer as the clock ticks down in this thriller.
GOAL! Incredible scenes! Zidroid turns it into his own goal! It's an all-own-goal classic! Singularity United level the score at two-all! Absolute madness!
Four own goals in this match! The teams are trading deflections like trading cards. Real Machina look stunned in their white kit, scrambling to steady the ship.
GOAL! Unbelievable! Haalandroid scores a third own goal of the day! Real Machina lead three-two with moments remaining! What a cruel twist of robotic fate!
Full time, Real Machina win three-two; what a chaotic start to the season!
